subject: Compute delta3 READY: 610/610 --candidate, 28 Rust, 7/7 producer, 134 textures, TLS header + draw v3
body:
Ready for root review/integration. Final host evidence:
- Integration from overnight/work root: `TEGU_AIR_BRIDGE_SO=... python3 gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py --candidate` => **610/610 checks, 0 required, 0 pending, ABI/candidate/producer/native/corpus/render/legacy/variant-thread all PASS**, release+ASan. Report copied to workers/compute/evidence-integration-final.json. (Native subtest uses cwd-relative `gpu/build/native/probe-compute.bc`; run from work root.)
- Rust 28/28 PASS; real producer 7/7 PASS compiler57db4be4, cdylib06a6c6ee, source277acb12; receipt build/compute-v2-producer-current-abi/result.json.
- Textures private n2mb_v2_job_test against production bridge: 134/134 PASS release+ASan (mips, 3D, 17-layer); ordinary levels1 16-plane bytes unchanged.
- C suite release+ASan PASS including TLS/WLS words17/18 and 5000-byte TGP2 code.
- Native compute frontend subtest PASS from work root.

Final production hashes:
air_bridge.rs 277acb12, air_bridge.h 9f0fa751 (resource488 + level facts + swizzle_valid), pipeline_format.h ff2889fc (TLS/WLS, 1MiB code, swizzle flag), compute_frontend.m bc9e283a (root fixes + Dispatch draw fields), runtime_pipeline.inc 92dc2c11, nord2_metal_bridge.c 41f8783d (mip/layer + dynamic16/23 + v3), nord2_metal_bridge.h 79928e7d, cdylib 06a6c6ee. n2mb_draw_v3 ready for render.

Remaining explicit: arbitrary per-level mip strides/noncontiguous offsets refuse; >23 combined levels/layers need separate payload ABI; atomic RMW transport/write tracking refuses with exact log; TLS/WLS requires lowering L2 rebuild from ff2889fc; custom borders/some depth/integer sampler combinations refuse; no phone/native/device/hardware claim.
